title: A Nested Doll-velopement Rerun: Ice Whisker
description: A Nested Doll-velopement Rerun: Ice Whisker — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to Collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to Collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Dungeon Runner, if I am going to be selling a new product I need to make sure I have enough supply to meet the demand. You have been doing such a great job in securing the Ice Whisker Nested Dolls for me so I hope you won't mind if I ask you to get another for me. Don't worry, I plan on giving you credit, it will just be in a font so small people won't be able to read it. Technically it will be there and isn't that all that matters.

Head back into the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, located off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 3. When you get there kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll. Return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston when you are done.

Turn-in:

Cha-ching! Look into my eyes, Dungeon Runner. Do you see King's Coin and piles of gold? Because that is all I see!

Objectives:

  • Ice Whisker Nested Doll ×1

Level range: 90–95
